cleanup.notes: Setup (npm ci in starter/) creates starter/node_modules, which holds Playwright 1.55.1 and the headless Chromium it downloads once (PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=0 keeps the browser inside the lab folder). Cleanup deletes starter/node_modules; the tests create nothing else. Resetting the learner's work means copying starter/app.js back from a fresh copy of the lab. The expected output file writes the variable timings as <ms>. The 30-minute cap is the S25 lab-block planning allowance and the 27-minute median is a task-by-task authoring re-estimate of the core path, tasks 1 to 5 (one rendering rewrite plus four short handlers with exact contracts inline); Task 6 is a stretch task beyond the core path and completing it completes the lab. Neither number is a measured learner pilot. All behavior is tested in the pinned headless Chromium against the page's own local files: the conditions API is a committed local fake with fixed answers and a 5 ms delay, the committed cross-site-scripting payload in data.js only sets a window flag the tests read, and the test browser aborts every non-file request. Tasks 3, 5 and 6 additionally check the starter source for the taught shape (a delegated list listener, then/catch, Promise.all, async/await) after stripping comments and strings.
